_comment: Quick 260508-pc0. Canonical _testatlas/ path patterns + known anti-patterns. Consumed by scripts/lint-commands.js Invariant 2 (path-canonicity). One-line comment per canonical pattern in adjacent _patterns_doc field.

antiPatterns.reason: flows are file pairs (FLOW-*.md + FLOW-*.json), not directories

_patterns_doc._testatlas/flows/FLOW-*.{md,json}: Flows are file pairs at the flat flows/ root, not subdirs.
_patterns_doc._testatlas/tests/runs/RUN-*.{md,json}: Test runs live under tests/runs/, never bare runs/.
_patterns_doc._testatlas/to_fix/by_*/<key>.md: to_fix axis indexes are by_<axis>/<key>.md (e.g. by_severity/critical.md).
_patterns_doc._testatlas/domains/<slug>/issues/index.m: Per-domain issue index lives at domains/<slug>/issues/index.md.
_patterns_doc._testatlas/brain/<canonical>.json: Brain state files: manifest, state, domains, flows, quality_scores, drift, events.
_patterns_doc._testatlas/evidence/<command>/<timestamp: Evidence directories nested by command name then timestamp.
_patterns_doc._testatlas/reports/REPORT-*.{md,json}: Reports are file pairs at reports/ root.
_patterns_doc._testatlas/<NN>_<name>.md: Numbered top-level workspace docs (system map, test strategy, etc).
